lines.text: Full of the Holy Spirit, Jesus is led into the wilderness, where the devil tempts Him for forty days.
The devil tells hungry Jesus to make a stone become bread, but Jesus answers that it is written.
The devil shows Jesus all the world's kingdoms from a mountain and offers them if Jesus will worship him.
The devil sets Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple in Bethlehem and dares Him to throw Himself down.
When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Jesus until an opportune time.
